items.title: Scope, identity and jurisdiction
items.required_evidence: Define first-level institution boundaries, exclusions, legal identity and an explicit as-of research question.

items.title: Original source and edition integrity
items.required_evidence: Independently retrieve, hash and bind exact government-source editions and legal instruments to their published records.

items.title: Complete first-level cohort
items.required_evidence: Reconcile the entire qualified first-level cohort at the declared effective date, including independent exceptions and residuals.

items.title: Statutory composition and limits
items.required_evidence: Identify applicable statutory establishment, organizational categories, exceptions, conditions, changes and temporal legal effect.

items.title: Typed structural relationships
items.required_evidence: Distinguish source placement, statutory composition, supervision, delegation, command, adjudicative independence and oversight.

items.title: Historical identity and succession
items.required_evidence: Reconcile documented redesignations, predecessor/successor functions and unresolved operative dates without inventing continuity.

items.title: Independent expert determinations
items.required_evidence: Obtain independently authenticated, appropriately scoped institutional and legal human-review decisions; preserve dissent.

items.title: Institutionally approved evidence custody
items.required_evidence: Bind evidence to ratified signer policy, exact-source digests and approved immutable retention; preserve the VA-specific 04E higher bar.

items.title: Independent audit and recovery
items.required_evidence: Verify reproducible independently authenticated source access, tamper evidence, and restoration of protected original evidence.
